response.sql: SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id

assumptions.assumption: Payments that link to a rental are those with a non-NULL rental_id matching an existing rental row (inner join). The combined total in the denominator covers only these linked payments, not all payments.
The fraction is expressed as a ratio between 0 and 1, not a percentage.
